templates.source: https://support.een.com/portal/en/kb/articles/adding-cameras-via-rtsp — Eagle Eye Networks Knowledge Base 'Adding Cameras Via RTSP' (v2.0, 2024-05-27): example RTSP path for 'Eagle Eye Networks cameras: snl/live/1/1'

notes: Eagle Eye Networks' own KB gives snl/live/1/1 as the RTSP path of Eagle Eye Networks cameras (the camera's first/main stream). No official sub-stream path is published, so none is listed. EEN cameras are normally connected to the EEN cloud via a Bridge/CMVR (ONVIF or EEN-native); RTSP access is described by EEN as a fallback.
